name: Virna Jandiroba
facts: Virna Carole Andrade Jandiroba is a Brazilian mixed martial artist who currently competes in the women's Strawweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). She is a former Invicta Fighting Championships (Invicta) Strawweight champion.
